nodes.label: Stepper

nodes.rationale: The v1.0.0 contract delegates Figma and React with two native Slots. It governs composing a question rather than presenting an agent response.

nodes.label: CHAT-SIDEBAR-001
nodes.rationale: The delegated v1.0.0 chain includes Chat Tool Item, Chat History Item, Chat Sidebar Section and Chat Plan Usage.

nodes.label: Selection controls

nodes.rationale: Body is the product-content interface; 24/16/8/4 internal composition and 32 between independent Cards remain current. Semantic-property colors and shape/inverse amendments extend roles without turning demonstration frames into a Card family.

nodes.label: FOUNDATIONS-TOKEN-VISIBILITY-001
nodes.rationale: Only component/body/* is the visible product token interface. Exact scopes and existing internal bindings are distinct from choices available on a new field; aliases and values are preserved.

nodes.label: FOUNDATIONS-PRODUCT-CONSUMPTION-001
nodes.rationale: Both workflows must consume official DS controls; only product-local molecules use Body. Missing atomic components block the affected composition.

nodes.label: CHAT-DOCUMENT-VIEWER-001
nodes.rationale: The base delegates the viewer Slot and document App Shell layout. The actions amendment preserves ID/key/version; later implementation QA resolves its initial Description/Slot and web-action pendings without expanding historical QA.

nodes.label: DROPDOWN-MENU-001-SEARCH
nodes.rationale: Optional search preserves the master, Slot and defaults; observed design remains distinct from derived web filtering and accessibility.

nodes.label: FORMS-APP-SHELL-PATTERNS-001
nodes.rationale: The approved v0.2 PDF delegates product composition patterns, including actions aligned to the input box; it creates no Form family and grants no global service, Figma or accessibility QA.

nodes.label: FOUNDATIONS-CAUTION-001
nodes.rationale: The authorized caution-orange/100–900 namespace preserves Servicios orange. Nine primitive, four semantic and eight component tokens extend Body/Badge/Linear Progress; Caution Badge has no stroke. Earlier family values remain preserved.

nodes.label: FOUNDATIONS-BODY-DISABLED-001
nodes.rationale: At the 2026-11-23 Body-disabled cut, four roles reused semantic aliases and property scopes, producing 61 Body and 1,536 effective tokens. Five Dropdown descriptions were corrected without version changes. The later Header/App Shell spacing cut added two tokens, producing 1,538; these dated inventories do not override the current Rail extension.

nodes.label: Tabs contextual usage
nodes.rationale: The explicitly approved 22-page PDF governs sibling-section navigation versus in-view Chip filtering. Shape, shared table or counter do not choose the family; manual activation and independent focus remain required. Preparation grants no installation or publication.

nodes.label: DEC-BLUEHEART-REPOSITORY-001
nodes.rationale: The initial isolated-base HOLD is historical for Migueluckleo/Blue-Heart-DS: explicit authorization on 2026-11-12 lifted HOLD_LOCAL_ONLY for that repository. Remote registration and channel activation remain separate operations.

nodes.label: DEC-WEB-COMPONENTS-001
nodes.rationale: P07 keeps React, TypeScript, Tailwind and Next.js with a local catalog, API, example and family-scoped QA; reading a documentary phase does not authorize building it.

nodes.label: DEC-SLOTS-REVIEW-001
nodes.rationale: Slot applicability and operations require evidence and QA within each family scope; a static example is insufficient.

nodes.label: DEC-PHOSPHOR-ICONS-001
nodes.rationale: The user chose Phosphor Icons as transversal source. This historical decision does not make external library metadata available in the current MCP snapshot.

nodes.label: Component token layer correction
nodes.rationale: Tokenized Figma and web component properties consume component variables, whose aliases pass through semantic to primitives; the correction applies to current versions.

nodes.label: DEC-FIGMA-FAMILY-PAGE-ORDER-001
nodes.rationale: New official family pages use canonical A–Z order while foundations and covers stay positioned and Playground remains after the family block; IDs/content are preserved.

nodes.rationale: The explicit request is to document the modified private Preview at 222:111 while preserving family/version. Documentary adoption follows DEC-AI-TECHNICAL-CLOSURE-001, not human approval of later artifacts; no app code, Figma writes, installation or publication is authorized by this request.

nodes.label: SRC-CHAT-DOCUMENT-VIEWER-ACTIONS-COMPLETION-20261119
nodes.rationale: A separate explicit completion request authorized implementation and QA, resolving operational pendings of the earlier documentary cut while preserving that historical source, canonical data, identity and version.

nodes.rationale: Blue Heart DS is the read-only root and AI Blueheart DS the P04 work destination, as explicitly confirmed on 2026-11-11. Source URLs/selectors do not assign work pages. Preserve originals, source-versus-destination IDs, capture hashes and scope; the initial access-only observation did not verify effective writing.

nodes.label: Implementation Registry
nodes.rationale: Dated implementation/readback records retain their original scopes; current documentary History and implemented Header/App Shell spacing are distinct outcomes.

nodes.label: CONVERSATION-RESPONSE-001
nodes.rationale: The delegated v1.0.0 response family remains the host of its private Preview; the base family and earlier implementation QA are preserved.

nodes.rationale: The existing amendment documents horizontal Title FILL/HUG and Badge HUG/HUG only, preserving family/version/tokens. Web remains STALE_FOR_PREVIEW_LAYOUT because its details still use flex-col; this is not a new implementation PASS.

nodes.rationale: The OBSERVED read-only snapshot is evidence rather than independent authority: local 222:111 differs from historical remote 218:1228, so no same-ID local before/after is fabricated. Raw evidence SHA-256 6bcf8265994899bd4c057072559cdbe71b8708da5c1d403a2e42310bb908b764.

nodes.rationale: Earlier documentary PASS covers 11 nodes, four instances/three components, 73 variables and inherited row layout. Resize, browser and new gestures were NOT_EXECUTED; Figma/code were unchanged.

nodes.label: DEC-CHAT-HISTORY-NOTIFICATION-DOCUMENTATION-001
nodes.rationale: The explicit request authorizes documenting 257:498. It preserves version, variants and Slots, records absent web property and old variant descriptions, and grants no writes or notification business rules.

nodes.label: DEC-HEADER-APP-SHELL-OWN-SPACING-001
nodes.rationale: The distinct explicit request authorizes replacing Body references in component-owned spacing, including Header overrides, and adapting web/QA. It preserves measures, product content, versions and older token values; no publication or installation.

nodes.label: CHAT-SIDEBAR-001
nodes.rationale: The panel/rail family composes History, Tool Item, Sidebar Section and Plan Usage, now using Chat Rail Item for persistent Rail navigation. Shared Content supports navigation in Rail and sections in Panel, with compact plan outside. History notification remains separately STALE_FOR_NOTIFICATION; it is not implemented by the Rail change.

nodes.label: Header CSS spacing
nodes.rationale: The Header exterior consumes --header-spacing-container-padding; inner blocks retain --header-spacing-padding, Content --header-spacing-none and Version info --header-spacing-content. The version group and block separators retain their own roles without changing public callbacks.

nodes.label: App Shell CSS spacing
nodes.rationale: Root gap and Content top consume --app-shell-spacing-none; --bh-app-shell-gap aliases --app-shell-spacing-content for Content/Main/body and conversation-preview gaps. The conversation chat region retains its own size token; component spacing does not consume Body roles.

nodes.label: CHAT-RAIL-ITEM-001
nodes.rationale: Delegated v1.0.0 navigation component opens an in-screen panel view and preserves active selection independently of keyboard focus. It replaces Rail navigation Icon Buttons, while immediate Panel actions remain Icon Button Ghost. The host owns active view and notifications.

nodes.label: CHAT-SIDEBAR-001-RAIL-ITEM
nodes.rationale: The amendment replaces only Rail navigation, removes the nine master minHeight constraints and documents native Content shared by five Rail and four Panel. It preserves existing view names, master identities, plan indicator and valid Panel Icon Buttons.

nodes.label: DEC-CHAT-RAIL-ITEM-001
nodes.rationale: The explicit decisions separate persistent view navigation from generic actions, choose Dot medium and a brand focus ring, remove Rail/Panel minimum height, and adopt user-added Rail Content with the existing Panel key. Selected appearance remains exactly neutral #0F172A.

nodes.label: SRC-CHAT-RAIL-ITEM-2026-11-24
nodes.rationale: The observed source had20 controls, four literal #0F172A selected surfaces and nine literal791px minima. The explicit request and later clarifications authorize the new navigation component, medium Dot, brand focus and Slot/height adjustments; observations alone are not authority.

nodes.label: Chat Rail Item documentary QA PASS
nodes.rationale: READY/CONTRACT_REVIEW follows the explicit component, states, page, Dot and scoped-token decisions. It checks16 roles and the nine height/Slot targets; documentary readiness is distinct from executed Figma/web QA.

nodes.label: Chat Rail Item implementation QA PASS
nodes.rationale: The scoped review verifies eight variants,20 migrated Rail instances,ten consumers,510 bindings/90 overrides with zero findings,16 new internal tokens and1,554 total Figma variables. Four-theme Chrome,TypeScript,19 tests and static build pass for Rail Item/Sidebar; this is not a new integral catalog suite PASS.

nodes.label: Chat Rail Item implementation evidence
nodes.rationale: Master662:19/page662:18 is alphabetically placed between Chat Plan Usage and Chat Sidebar. The receipt links readback/mapping,20 replacements,ten consumers,nine height tests and Content instance operations to normative contracts and executed QA.

nodes.label: Rail navigation versus Icon Button
nodes.rationale: Persistent active view, panel navigation and host-owned novelty indication justify a separate Chat Rail Item. Use Icon Button Ghost for immediate Panel actions such as Search/Close, and retain four known accessible view names.

nodes.label: Rail Selected, Focus and Disabled states
nodes.rationale: Eight variants combine State Default/Hover/Focus/Disabled with Selected false/true; Default/false is base. Focus retains selection and web uses :focus-visible. Disabled retains prior active state while blocking native activation. Icon and Show notification persist across combinations.

nodes.label: Rail neutral selected alias
nodes.rationale: Default selected surface is chat-rail-item/color/bg/selected→neutral-maximum→neutral/900=#0F172A with white icon in all four themes. Other surface/icon roles remain neutral; brand focus does not recolor persistent selection.

nodes.label: Rail brand-strong focus ring
nodes.rationale: Focus consumes the same brand-strong semantic role as Icon Button. The56×56 contour has radius12 and2px INSIDE stroke, separated2px from the48×48 control. Executed QA resolves its focus color to blue/500=#272FD5 in all modes.

nodes.label: Rail notification medium Dot
nodes.rationale: Show notification defaults false and reuses local Dot notification/medium/default32:40,12×12, top/right inset4. It indicates presence rather than count and can coexist with selection,focus or disabled. Opening a view does not implicitly clear it; Dot retains its own tokens.

nodes.label: Chat Rail Item token roles
nodes.rationale: specs/tokens/chat-rail-item.v1.0.0.json, SHA-256 bbedf30b2a5ffbe286bfb082437a50e8f99a309503a4d5c4f8b7283b05622c70, defines16 component/chat-rail-item roles with scopes=[], WEB syntax and identical semantic aliases in Contable/Administrativo/Servicios/Personas. Dot is reused rather than duplicated.

nodes.label: Five-Rail instance migration
nodes.rationale: Five Rail variants each consume four Chat Rail Item instances in Chats/Indicadores/Papeles de trabajo/Vinculaciones order, for20 replacements. View none selects none; other views select one matching item. Existing48px boxes,32px interval,glyphs and positions are preserved; Panel actions stay Ghost small.

nodes.label: Host-defined Sidebar height
nodes.rationale: Five Rail and four Panel masters have minHeight=null; their791px samples and79/264px reference widths are retained. Content has its own observed32px minimum. Rail has no intrinsic scroll; very low space or custom-list overflow remains a host decision.

nodes.label: Shared native Content#258:0
nodes.rationale: The same native Slot property spans five Rail and four Panel. Rail Content is a direct child before compact plan; Panel Content is inside Content region after shortcuts. Rail is vertical Fill/Fill,top/center,gap32,padding0,no clipping/own scroll,stretchChildOnInsert; min/max children are null,preferredValues=[],allowPreferredValuesOnly=false,displayEmptyByDefault=false. Four items are a sample,not a limit.

nodes.label: Delegated Rail Content data
nodes.rationale: specs/data/chat-sidebar.rail-content.v1.0.0.json, SHA-256 81937696ccf2ef94aa674cb6e69e7860827aa34cbf1c273d05cebdad83296176, records all nine IDs,Slot settings and sample sizing. Source/logical identifiers remain distinct from actual implementation mappings.

nodes.label: Web Content children semantics
nodes.rationale: Omitted children renders the four reference views configured by railItems showNotification/disabled per view. Custom children replaces that navigation, while children=null leaves it empty. The compact plan stays outside. The host assigns selection and empty-list meaning; Panel children still holds sections.

nodes.label: Rail QA boundaries
nodes.rationale: Ten consumers comprise four App Shell and six Playground instances. Nine test instances resized to440px retained width. Rail Content tests covered four/zero/one/five items,reorder,replace and Rail View change with Dot persistence; tests were removed. Override preservation across Mode Rail/Panel and arbitrarily low heights was not certified, nor was the full catalog browser suite rerun.

nodes.label: Native view button semantics
nodes.rationale: A native button controls an in-screen panel, exposing aria-pressed, native disabled, the view name and visible-notification description Tiene novedades. Enter/Space activation is native; the host manages selected view and novelty value separately from focus.

nodes.label: Chat Rail Item CSS state composition
nodes.rationale: aria-pressed composes neutral selected colors with hover/disabled, while :focus-visible::after draws an independent tokenized focus contour with pointer-events:none. The notification wrapper is absolute at the token inset and does not intercept pointer events; component-owned size/radius/icon/spacing roles are consumed.

nodes.label: Chat Sidebar CSS Content layout
nodes.rationale: Sidebar flex layout permits min-block-size0. Panel Content flexes with overflow:auto; Rail navigation is a flexible column with centered items and tokenized section gap. The style supports host height reduction without imposing the old791px sample as a minimum.
